messages:
elaine: Heads-up  we need a tight preflight for the gated webinar launch tomorrow. Items: keyword <> LP mapping, JSON-LD (WebinarEvent + FAQ), canonical rules, internal links from docs, promo redirect plan, and lead routing payload specifics for SFDC. Who will own what?

priya: I can run the master checklist and own tracking. Proposed primary keywords: 'low-latency LLM inference' (commercial intent) and 'inference cost optimization' (research/ops intent). Will map to 3 landing templates: webinar LP, gated ebook, and product brief.

marco: I'll handle keyword mapping and structured data. Plan: include WebinarEvent JSON-LD on LP with startDate/endDate, location: Online, and organizer. Also add FAQPage JSON-LD for top registration Qs. Add canonical link tag, breadcrumbList, and ensure the blog post canonical points to LP where applicable. Will put snippets in the prelaunch doc.

jun: Content ops here  draft copy almost ready. I will add 4 contextual internal links: docs/runtime -> batching guide, docs/kv-cache -> reference, product/overview -> features, and resources/benchmarks -> throughput report. Will set anchor text to targeted keywords without keyword-stuffing.

dalia: Redirect plan from infra side: prefer 301s for promo shortlinks to preserve equity. Temporary test pages use 302 until variant judged. Example nginx snippet for ops team: 
```
location = /promo/llm-webinar-2026 {
  return 301 /product/inference-webinar?utm=promo_link;
}
location = /old-ebook-page {
  return 302 /resources/ebook-inference?utm=ab_test;
}
```
Also will add noindex to staging/preview pages and schedule a CDN cache purge at launch + invalidation for redirect rules after 48h if we flip.

priya: Reminder: if we use UTM params, add canonical tags on LP to the canonical URL without UTMs and use Search Console parameter handling to avoid duplicate indexing. Marco, add sitemap entries for new LPs and request indexing post-launch.

marco: Will do. Also recommend running the Rich Results test and the schema validator on the final HTML. No hreflang needed (en-US).

elaine: Lead routing details: form POST should hit /px/webhook and create an SFDC lead with campaign = WEBINAR-JUN-26. Required fields: email, utm_source, utm_campaign, keyword_bucket, landing_id, variant_id, gdpr_opt_in. Jun, can you confirm payload shape?

jun: Confirmed. Sample payload I'll validate and share Postman: 
```
{
  "email": "attendee@example.com",
  "utm_source": "twitter",
  "utm_campaign": "webinar_jun26",
  "keyword_bucket": "kw-inference-low-latency",
  "landing_id": "lp-webinar-jun26",
  "variant_id": "optA",
  "gdpr_opt_in": true
}
```
I'll include a test harness that asserts required fields and returns 200 + lead_id.

dalia: Infra note  feature flag gate flips at 09:00 PT on launch day. We'll coordinate a config rollout and automated CDN purge. For redirects, we'll push rules to the edge and log hits for the first 72h.

priya: On messaging tests: run headline A/B via Optimizely - A: 'Real-time LLM inference at predictable cost' vs B: 'Production-grade latency for LLMs'. Record variant_id in webhook so we can tie to lead quality and MQL conversion. We'll run for 7 days and review conversion rate + downstream SQLs.

marco: Also add microdata for eventAttendanceMode: 'Online' and set isAccessibleForFree based on registration flow. I'll paste final JSON-LD into the checklist and run the structured data tester.

elaine: Great. Action owners recap: Marco  schema + sitemap + structured data tests. Priya  master checklist + A/B tracking. Jun  payload + Postman + test harness. Dalia  redirect rules, CDN purge schedule, feature flag. Everyone  final checks in prelaunch doc by 08:30 PT tomorrow. /remind #marketing in 18h to final review. :rocket:
